author: Mark Atwood
text: Confirmed repro on worker5 (cbor2 6.1.3 venv, full suite run): test_vector_generator_cli.py::{test_packets_timing_check,test_authenticated_dio_check,test_hash32_check}_is_byte_exact_and_read_only + test_vectors.py::test_all_vector_documents_have_explicit_schema_policy all FAIL, consistent with the group-writable/atomic_json parent-refusal class. Also failing in same run, likely same workspace-permission root: tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py::test_committed_ipv6_address_vectors_match_stdlib_generator and tests/test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py::test_committed_icmpv6_vectors_match_stdlib_generator. Total 6 vector-side failures beyond the 4 edhoc timing ones (up5p).
